outstanding.translationZh: 我的学校对使用信用卡支付未结清费用收取额外费用，这可能会使账单金额增加高达余额的3%。

outstanding.sentenceEn: But she says the results still suggest women in geoscience are at a potential disadvantage from the very beginning of their careers starting with those less than outstanding letters of recommendation.
outstanding.translationZh: 但她说，研究结果仍然表明，地球科学领域的女性从职业生涯一开始就可能处于潜在的不利地位，而这种不利正是源于那些不够出色的推荐信。
outstanding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

outstanding.sentenceEn: They found that female applicants were only half as likely to get outstanding letters, compared with their male counterparts.
outstanding.translationZh: 他们发现，与男性申请者相比，女性申请者获得优秀推荐信的可能性只有前者的一半。
outstanding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

outstanding.sentenceEn: Carême wanted to show to later generations that French chefs of his time were most outstanding in the world.
outstanding.translationZh: 卡雷姆想要向后代证明，他那个时代的法国厨师是世界上最杰出的。

outstanding.sentenceEn: He is not outstanding in Science and Math.
outstanding.translationZh: 他在理科和数学方面的表现并不突出。

oven.sentenceEn: But if gravity is removed, the beans float around in a heated oven , receiving 360 degrees of evenly distributed heat and roast to near perfection.
oven.translationZh: 但如果去除重力，咖啡豆会在加热的容器中漂浮，接受360度均匀分布的热量，烤至近乎完美。
oven.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

oven.sentenceEn: Popping food into the microwave for a couple of minutes may seem utterly harmless, but Europe's stock of these quick-cooking ovens emits as much carbon as nearly 7 million cars, a new study has found.
oven.translationZh: 把食物放进微波炉加热几分钟似乎完全无害，但一项新研究发现，欧洲现有的这些快速烹饪炉具所排放的碳量相当于近700万辆汽车的排放量。
oven.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

oven.sentenceEn: Among common kitchen appliances used for cooking, microwaves are the most energy efficient, followed by a stove and finally a standard oven .
oven.translationZh: 在常用的厨房烹饪电器中，微波炉是最节能的，其次是 stove（炉灶），最后是标准烤箱。
oven.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

oven.sentenceEn: This is 10 times the amount this new microwave oven study estimates for annual emissions for all the microwave ovens in the EU.
oven.translationZh: 这一数字是这项新的微波炉研究估算的欧盟所有微波炉年排放量的10倍。
oven.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

oven.sentenceEn: Forgetting how to operate a familiar object like a microwave oven , or forgetting how to drive to the house of a friend you've visited many times before can also be signs of something going wrong.
oven.translationZh: 忘记如何操作像微波炉这样熟悉的物品，或者忘记如何开车去你拜访过多次的朋友家，也可能是出现问题的迹象。
oven.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

oven.sentenceEn: They float around in the oven .
oven.translationZh: 咖啡豆会在烤箱中四处漂浮

overwhelming.sentenceEn: They have a reputation of being overly strict with the students, not to mention the overwhelming amount of homework they assign, which would lead to a lot of pressure for Jake and me.
overwhelming.translationZh: 他们出了名的对学生过于严厉，更不用说布置的海量作业了，这会给杰克和我带来巨大的压力。
overwhelming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

overwhelming.sentenceEn: W: How utterly overwhelming and dull!
overwhelming.translationZh: 这真是既让人倍感压力又枯燥乏味啊！
overwhelming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

overwhelming.sentenceEn: This means they have overwhelming negative emotions towards the subject, ranging from rage to despair.
overwhelming.translationZh: 这意味着他们对数学这门学科怀有强烈的负面情绪，从愤怒到绝望不等。
overwhelming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

overwhelming.sentenceEn: "Support from trusted relationships is vital. This includes professional support from various health and wellness providers if stress is becoming increasingly overwhelming ."
overwhelming.translationZh: 值得信赖的人际关系所提供的支持至关重要。如果压力变得越来越难以承受，这还包括来自各种健康和 wellness 服务提供者的专业支持。

overwhelming.sentenceEn: If anything, the information is overwhelming .
overwhelming.translationZh: 事实上，信息多得让人不知所措。

overwhelming.sentenceEn: The desire for a future reward is overwhelming .
overwhelming.translationZh: 对未来奖励的渴望是强烈的。

occasion.sentenceEn: Jordan Jax and Tarod Goodman, both 23, were arrested after evidence gathered in an investigation showed the pair stole mail on multiple occasions using a postal key, according to a news release.
occasion.translationZh: 据新闻稿称，23岁的乔丹·贾克斯和塔罗德·古德曼因调查中收集的证据显示两人多次使用邮政钥匙盗窃邮件而被捕。
occasion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

occasion.sentenceEn: We all take a little extra effort to look nice for special occasions .
occasion.translationZh: 在特殊场合，我们都会格外努力打扮得漂亮一些。
occasion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

occasion.sentenceEn: My mother, who is just shy of five feet tall, is normally incredibly soft-spoken, but on the rare occasion when she got angry, she was terrifying.
occasion.translationZh: 我母亲身高刚不足五英尺，平时说话声音特别轻柔，但在极少数她生气的时候，她会变得十分吓人。

occasion.sentenceEn: On what occasion did Gerald Ratner explain the secret of his success?
occasion.translationZh: 杰拉尔德·拉特纳是在什么场合解释他成功的秘诀的？

occasion.sentenceEn: They wear hats on social occasions .
occasion.translationZh: 他们在社交场合会戴帽子。

origin.sentenceEn: The Norwalk Fire Marshal is investigating the cause and origin of the fire.
origin.translationZh: 诺沃克消防局长正在调查火灾的原因和起火点。
origin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

origin.sentenceEn: Crews had the fire under control in about 45 minutes and managed to contain the fire to its point of origin .
origin.translationZh: 消防队员约在45分钟内控制住了火势，并成功将火势限制在起火点。
origin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

origin.sentenceEn: It's harder to pin down the origins of the oft-quoted five-second rule, but a 2003 study reported that 70% of women and 56% of men surveyed were familiar with the five-second rule and that women were more likely than men to eat food that had dropped on the floor.
origin.translationZh: 很难确定常被提及的"五秒规则"的起源，但2003年的一项研究显示，接受调查的女性中有70%、男性中有56%熟悉这一规则，且女性比男性更有可能吃掉在地上的食物。

origin.sentenceEn: Yuka Sasaki and her colleagues at Brown University set out to investigate the origins of this effect.
origin.translationZh: 布朗大学的由香·佐佐木（Yuka Sasaki）及其同事着手研究这种效应的起源。
origin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

origin.sentenceEn: There are a number of different versions about the origin of the lion dance.
origin.translationZh: 关于舞狮的起源，有许多不同的说法。

origin.sentenceEn: Their origins can no longer be traced.
origin.translationZh: 它们的起源已无从考证。

overwhelm.sentenceEn: It's easy to get overwhelmed just thinking about it.
overwhelm.translationZh: 光是想想就让人不知所措。

overwhelm.sentenceEn: He recalled attending Formula One's Monaco race last year and being overwhelmed by the ceremony leading up to the event, the way the race charmed the city for days ahead of the start.
overwhelm.translationZh: 他回忆起去年观看一级方程式摩纳哥大奖赛时的情景，开赛前的一系列仪式让他印象深刻，而这场赛事在开赛数天前就已让整个城市为之倾倒。

overwhelm.sentenceEn: Three days later, you're overwhelmed by how much is on your to-do list.
overwhelm.translationZh: 三天后，你就会被待办清单上堆积如山的任务压得喘不过气来。

overwhelm.sentenceEn: Professor Wilding disagrees that labelling a high proportion of the population as having a disease removes personal responsibility or may overwhelm health services, pointing out that other common diseases, such as high blood pressure and diabetes, require people to take action to manage their condition.
overwhelm.translationZh: 怀尔丁教授不同意将大部分人口贴上患病标签会免除个人责任或可能使医疗服务不堪重负的观点，他指出，其他常见疾病如高血压和糖尿病，也要求人们采取行动来管理自己的病情。
overwhelm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

overwhelm.sentenceEn: Any device that's built to receive a wireless signal at a specific frequency can be overwhelmed by a stronger signal coming in on the same frequency.
overwhelm.translationZh: 任何旨在接收特定频率无线信号的设备，都可能被同一频率上更强的信号干扰而无法正常工作。

overwhelm.sentenceEn: Obese people would be overwhelmed with anxiety.
overwhelm.translationZh: 肥胖人群会陷入极度焦虑之中。
